title: bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-14
summary: bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 14, 2026, disclosing a press release about a clinical case study for its CyPath Lung diagnostic test. The filing is a routine corporate disclosure with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Registrant: bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. (Nasdaq: BIAF, BIAFW) — a micro-cap biotech company based in San Antonio, Texas
Filed Form 8-K on April 14, 2026 pursuant to Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934
Item 8.01 disclosure: Company issued press release announcing a new clinical case study for CyPath Lung, a noninvasive sputum-based diagnostic test
The case study involved a high-risk patient with a suspicious pulmonary nodule where imaging suggested high cancer likelihood but physician suspected inflammation
Exhibit 99.1 (press release) and Exhibit 104 (XBRL data) are attached
Signed by Maria Zannes, President and CEO, on April 14, 2026
